overview_description.description: Etmana is a fashion marketplace based in Egypt that is designed to bring traditional fashion stores online. We serve four key categories: Women, Men, Kids, and Beauty, and recently launched our social commerce feature “Shop with Friends”, which transforms shopping into a shared experience with family and friends.
